task: Compute the sum of the list (list 2 3 5 7) using fold-right; store it via (rlm-set answer ...) then (rlm-set Final true).
lesson: Today I learned that fold-right reverses list order, which can break intuitive summing logic.

nodes.code: (define (sum-list lst)~~NL~~  (fold-right (lambda (x acc) (+ x acc)) 0 lst))~~NL~~(let ((lst (list 2 3 5 7)))~~NL~~  (set! answer (sum-list lst))~~NL~~  (set! Final t))~~NL~~(final true)
(let ((lst (list 2 3 5 7)))~~NL~~  (rlm-set answer (fold-right (lambda (x acc) (+ x acc)) 0 lst))~~NL~~  (rlm-set Final t))
